Name: Pac-Man Fruit Ghosts for Cornucopia
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
Once again I am delving into Namco lore to make another set of fruit ghosts. This time, you get 17.

This mod add more ghosts to my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24869]Pac-Man Fruit Ghosts[/url] mod. These will make fruits and such from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url]. I think I covered most of them. Might have missed some things. Each ghost will make two fruits depending on friendship as always.  The graphics are edited from Pac-Man Arrangement (1996). Sprites were ripped by Techokami on Spriter's Resource.

You will need those two mods for this one to work. If you have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] addon for fruit ghosts, they'll work with that too.﻿

These ones do not reproduce, no baby textures. Mostly because I was lazy but also because some of these ghosts are already children anyway so it seemed weird.

Transparent variants for the ghosts are also included, just replace the main folder copies with the transparent folder ones.

Not super extensively tested so let me know if you encounter issues.


Some pretty obscure ghosts this time. Tangy/Zesty/Juicy/Slushy are names I made up for the player ghosts from Pac-Man Party Royale. Blasty and Itchy are also from that.
Gulp/Grace/Dan/Wimpy are the ghosts from Golly! Ghost!, another Namco game. I am not 100% sure if these names are official, but they're all I could find.
Baby is a green ghost from Ms. Pac-Man Quest For The Golden Maze.
Blunder is from Pac-Man World 2, Golvis from Pac 'n Roll.
Kelly/Rocky/Harry/Terry are from some IRL stores called Pac-Store.
